# Contribution Workflow

Sydeso uses issue-first collaboration.

```txt
Issue -> Project item -> Branch/PR -> Review/checks -> Merge -> Project status update
```

## Contributor Rules

- Pick or create a GitHub Issue before implementation.
- Ensure the issue is represented on the Project board.
- Open a branch/PR linked to the issue.
- Run validation before requesting review.
- Include screenshots for UI changes.
- Update docs when behavior or architecture changes.

Read `CONTRIBUTING.md` and `docs/RULES.md` before contributing.
